messages.text: Mulder shreds Bangladesh as South Africa seal 2-0 sweep before England Tests

metadata.summary: South Africa's Wiaan Mulder followed his fifth Test century with career-best bowling figures of 7-31 as the Proteas routed Bangladesh by an innings and 219 runs inside three days to secure a 2-0 sweep ahead of their three-match series versus England.
metadata.content: South Africa thrash Bangladesh to seal 2-0 sweep before England Test series as Wiaan Mulder takes seven-wicket haul | Cricket News | Sky Sports Skip to main content South Africa thrash Bangladesh to seal 2-0 sweep before England Test series as Wiaan Mulder takes seven-wicket haul South Africa host England in a three-Test series live on Sky Sports from December 17, with matches at Johannesburg, Centurion and Cape Town; Proteas hammer Bangladesh inside three days at SuperSport Park to consolidate top spot in World Test Championship Wednesday 25 November 2026 13:54, UK Image: South Africa's Wiaan Mulder took a seven-wicket haul after scoring a century in his side's innings thrashing of Bangladesh South Africa's Wiaan Mulder followed his fifth Test century with career-best bowling figures of 7-31 as the Proteas routed Bangladesh by an innings and 219 runs inside three days to secure a 2-0 sweep ahead of their three-match series versus England. Mulder's knock of 100 from 178 balls came in the hosts' 494-7 declared at Centurion, before the tourists were rolled for 184 in their second dig, having been blown away for 91 on day one of the game when Kagiso Rabada and Marco Jansen shared six wickets. South Africa, who face England at home in Tests for the first time since 2020 when the opening game takes place in Johannesburg from December 17, consolidated their position at the top of the World Test Championship as they target back-to-back titles. messages.text: Sterling given suspended jail sentence for dangerous driving

metadata.summary: Former England player Raheem Sterling has been given a suspended 12-month jail sentence for dangerous driving and possession of nitrous oxide after a crash involving a Lamborghini on the motorway.
metadata.content: Raheem Sterling: Former England international given suspended 12-month jail sentence for dangerous driving | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Raheem Sterling: Former England international given suspended 12-month jail sentence for dangerous driving Raheem Sterling pleaded guilty at Basingstoke Magistrates' Court in September and admitted possession of six nitrous oxide cannisters for wrongful inhalation and failing to provide a specimen Wednesday 25 November 2026 11:37, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Sky Sports' Geraint Hughes gives the latest as Raheem Sterling is given a suspended 12-month jail sentence Former England player Raheem Sterling has been given a suspended 12-month jail sentence for dangerous driving and possession of nitrous oxide after a crash involving a Lamborghini on the motorway. Sterling pleaded guilty at Basingstoke Magistrates' Court in September to driving a Lamborghini Urus dangerously on the M25, the M3, the A327 and Minley Road before he crashed on May 28. The sentence is suspended for 18 months. He has also been handed a two-year driving ban and must undertake 100 hours of unpaid community work. Sterling will have to re-take a driving test to hold a licence. Raheem Sterling's career was defined by comebacks - this could be one too many The 31-year-old admitted possession of six nitrous oxide cannisters for wrongful inhalation, a class C drug, and failing to provide a specimen. messages.text: Rinderknech denies refusing doping test and expects to be cleared

metadata.summary: France's Arthur Rinderknech is confident he will be cleared of an alleged refusal to undergo a doping test.
metadata.content: Arthur Rinderknech denies refusing to take anti-doping test after charge confirmed for French tennis player | Tennis News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Arthur Rinderknech denies refusing to take anti-doping test after charge confirmed for French tennis player French newspaper L'Equipe reported Arthur Rinderknech's alleged refusal to take doping test; International ‌Tennis Integrity Agency has since confirmed charge; former ⁠Wimbledon champion Marketa Vondrousova handed four-year ban in June after tribunal found she refused test Wednesday 25 November 2026 11:15, UK Image: France's Arthur Rinderknech has denied refusing to take an anti-doping test in June France's Arthur Rinderknech is confident he will be cleared of an alleged refusal to undergo a doping test. The International ‌Tennis Integrity Agency [ITIA] confirmed on Wednesday that the 31-year-old had been charged for refusing a test in Brittany in June after French newspaper L'Equipe initially reported in their story that he was facing a four-year ban. Rinderknech denied the allegation on Instagram, while stressing that he has never taken a banned substance and revealing he has asked for the ​matter to be heard by an independent tribunal.
